title.zh: 纯洁度测试（Rice Purity）：100项经历清单

seoTitle.zh: 纯洁度测试（Rice Purity）：100项经历清单

description.en: Explore an independent 100-item adult experience checklist. Get a transparent 0–100 score, review or clear your selections, and save a score-only image.
description.zh: 一份独立创作的100项成人经历清单。勾选后查看可复算的0—100分，随时修改或清空选择，保存不包含逐题答案的结果图片。

introduction.en: An independently written checklist inspired by the Rice Purity format. It is not the classic original question set and scores are not directly comparable across versions.
introduction.zh: 本清单沿用Rice Purity的自评形式，题目为独立创作，并非经典原版；不同版本的分数不能直接比较。

instructions.zh: 仅限成年人。包含性、酒精及物质、法律经历；不想回答的项目可以不勾选。不勾选与未经历在计算上相同，不能因此推断你的完整经历。分数不评价道德、健康或个人价值，也不是需要完成的挑战。
instructions.en: For adults only. Includes sexual, alcohol/substance and legal experiences. Leave any item unchecked if you prefer not to answer. Skipping and not having an experience count the same, so the score cannot describe your full history. It is not a judgment of character, health or worth, or a challenge to complete.

source.kind: Independently authored 100-item adult experience checklist inspired by the general self-graded Rice Purity format. No competitor wording, sequence or explanation collection reproduced. Explicitly not the classic/original/official question set.

prompt.zh: 与有好感的人牵手散步过。
prompt.en: Walked hand in hand with someone I was romantically interested in.

prompt.zh: 主动邀请过别人单独约会。

prompt.zh: 曾在饮酒后第二天感到宿醉不适。

prompt.zh: 曾因饮酒而呕吐。

prompt.zh: 曾在原本不打算喝酒的日子里喝酒。

prompt.zh: 曾为了不让别人知道而隐瞒自己喝过酒。

prompt.zh: 主动使用过电子烟。

prompt.zh: 在娱乐目的下食用过含大麻的食品。

prompt.zh: 在非医疗目的下使用过兴奋类药物。

prompt.zh: 在非医疗目的下使用过致幻物质。

prompt.zh: 曾在使用酒精或其他物质后为自己的行为后悔。
prompt.en: Regretted an action after using alcohol or another substance.

prompt.zh: 曾未经允许进入限制进入的地点。
prompt.en: Entered a restricted place without permission.

prompt.zh: 曾未经付款拿走商店商品。
prompt.en: Taken merchandise from a shop without paying.

prompt.zh: 曾故意损坏不属于自己的物品。
prompt.en: Deliberately damaged property that was not mine.

prompt.zh: 曾因自己的行为被警察询问。
prompt.en: Been questioned by police about my own conduct.

prompt.zh: 曾因自己的行为收到罚单。
prompt.en: Received a citation for my own conduct.

prompt.zh: 曾被逮捕或拘留。
prompt.en: Been arrested or detained.

prompt.zh: 曾被法院判定犯有刑事罪行。
prompt.en: Been convicted of a criminal offence by a court.

prompt.zh: 曾在监禁场所服刑。
prompt.en: Served a custodial sentence.

prompt.zh: 曾明知不符合入场条件仍使用不实身份资料入场。
prompt.en: Used false identity details to enter a venue whose requirements I did not meet.

prompt.zh: 曾在被明确要求离开后继续留在私人场所。
prompt.en: Stayed on private premises after being explicitly asked to leave.

prompt.zh: 曾在考试中使用未经允许的资料。
prompt.en: Used unauthorized material during an examination.

prompt.zh: 曾把别人的作业当成自己的提交。
prompt.en: Submitted someone else's assignment as my own.

prompt.zh: 曾在写作中故意隐瞒借用他人文字的来源。
prompt.en: Intentionally omitted the source of borrowed writing.

prompt.zh: 曾伪造过出勤记录。
prompt.en: Falsified an attendance record.

prompt.zh: 曾向老师虚构缺席理由。
prompt.en: Invented a reason for an absence to a teacher.

prompt.zh: 曾收到学校的正式纪律处分。
prompt.en: Received formal disciplinary action from a school.

prompt.zh: 曾在未经允许的情况下更改正式记录。
prompt.en: Altered an official record without permission.

prompt.zh: 曾为逃避后果而把自己的错误归咎于别人。
prompt.en: Blamed someone else for my own mistake to avoid consequences.

prompt.zh: 曾在承诺保密后仍泄露别人的秘密。
prompt.en: Disclosed another person's secret after promising confidentiality.

prompt.zh: 曾为了个人利益隐瞒本应说明的重要事实。
prompt.en: Withheld an important fact I should have disclosed for personal gain.

summary.zh: 理解0—100分、跳过项目、版本差异与分享边界。
summary.en: Understand the 0–100 score, skipped items, edition differences and sharing boundaries.

scoreReading.zh: 100个项目每项权重均为1。只计算你主动勾选的不同项目：勾选3项得97分；取消其中1项后得98分；全部不勾选得100分；全部勾选得0分。
scoreReading.en: All 100 items carry one point. Only distinct items you actively check count: three checked items give 97; unchecking one gives 98; none checked gives 100; all checked gives 0.

paragraphs.zh: 本版以Rice Purity的100项勾选形式为灵感，题目、分组与解释均为费马独立创作。它不是经典原版、莱斯大学官方测试或任何其他网站的复制版。
paragraphs.en: This edition takes inspiration from the 100-checkbox Rice Purity format. FermatMind independently authored the items, grouping and explanations. It is not the classic original, an official Rice University test or a copy of another website.

paragraphs.zh: 题本标识为FM Experience 100 v1。题目改变会改变分数含义；即使两个版本都给出97分，也不代表经历相同，请勿跨版本排位或比较。
paragraphs.en: The edition is FM Experience 100 v1. Different items change what a score describes. Two editions can both give 97 without representing the same experiences; do not rank or compare scores across editions.

title.en: How scoring works: 100 minus checked items

paragraphs.zh: 100个项目每项权重均为1。只计算你主动勾选的不同项目：勾选3项得97分；取消其中1项后得98分；全部不勾选得100分；全部勾选得0分。
paragraphs.en: All 100 items carry one point. Only distinct items you actively check count: three checked items give 97; unchecking one gives 98; none checked gives 100; all checked gives 0.

paragraphs.zh: 页面上的“已勾选”是选择数量，不是完成率。分数没有人口常模、百分位或经过验证的高低分区间；它也不是人格类型或生活成熟度。
paragraphs.en: The checked-item counter measures selections, not completion. There are no population norms, percentiles or validated score bands. The number is not a personality type or a measure of maturity.

paragraphs.zh: 未经历和不想回答都可以不勾选，两者在计算中相同。你不必解释跳过的原因，也不用为了查看结果回答所有敏感项目。100分只说明本轮没有勾选项目，不能证明你没有任何相关经历。
paragraphs.en: Leave an item unchecked if it has not happened or you prefer not to answer. Both count the same. You do not need to explain a skip or disclose every sensitive experience to see a result. A score of 100 means no items were checked this round; it cannot prove an absence of experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 答题不要求注册、姓名或出生日期。选择仅在当前页面内存中计算，不保存到本地草稿，不随分享链接发送。刷新、关闭页面或重测会清除选择；清空操作需要确认。
paragraphs.en: No account, name or birth date is required. Selections are evaluated in the current page’s memory, without a saved local draft or answers in sharing links. Reloading, closing the page or retaking clears them; clearing selections asks for confirmation.

paragraphs.zh: 可下载的结果图只包含分数、勾选数、本版标识和公开入口，不包含逐题选择或分类统计。即使只有分数，也可能让人作出不准确的推断；你可以选择不分享，不应被要求交出分数或截图。
paragraphs.en: The downloadable card includes only the score, checked count, edition and public entry, without item selections or category totals. Even a score can invite inaccurate assumptions. Sharing is optional; nobody should require your score or screenshot.

title.en: What this score cannot tell you

paragraphs.zh: “纯洁度”是玩法名称，不是对道德、健康、可靠程度或个人价值的评价。分数不能用于诊断、判断性健康、选择伴侣或推断别人的完整经历。遇到不适可以立即离开。
paragraphs.en: “Purity” names the format; it does not evaluate morality, health, reliability or worth. The score cannot diagnose, assess sexual health, select a partner or reveal someone’s full history. Leave whenever you feel uncomfortable.

paragraphs.zh: 清单不是待办挑战，不建议为了降低或提高分数去尝试任何行为。成年、同意与个人界限优先；请勿要求他人证明某项经历。
paragraphs.en: This is not a to-do challenge. Do not try an activity to raise or lower a score. Adulthood, consent and personal boundaries come first; do not demand proof of another person’s experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 清单按经历主题分组，你可以随时跳到某组、更改勾选、只查看已勾选项或返回全部100项。查看结果不会锁定选择；“返回修改”保留本轮选择，“清空全部”确认后回到0项。
paragraphs.en: The checklist is grouped by experience topic. Jump to a group, change selections, review checked items or return to all 100. Viewing a result does not lock your choices: edit keeps the current selections; confirmed clear resets them to zero.

answer.en: Leave an item unchecked if it has not happened or you prefer not to answer. Both count the same. You do not need to explain a skip or disclose every sensitive experience to see a result. A score of 100 means no items were checked this round; it cannot prove an absence of experiences.

answer.zh: 本版以Rice Purity的100项勾选形式为灵感，题目、分组与解释均为费马独立创作。它不是经典原版、莱斯大学官方测试或任何其他网站的复制版。
answer.en: This edition takes inspiration from the 100-checkbox Rice Purity format. FermatMind independently authored the items, grouping and explanations. It is not the classic original, an official Rice University test or a copy of another website.

question.zh: 需要答完敏感问题才能看结果吗？
question.en: Must I disclose every sensitive experience?

answer.zh: 不需要。任何项目都可以不勾选，结果只按本轮主动勾选数计算；它不能描述你的完整经历。
answer.en: No. Leave anything unchecked. The result uses only items actively checked this round and cannot describe your complete history.

question.zh: 会保存或分享我的逐题答案吗？
question.en: Are my item selections saved or shared?

answer.zh: 答题不要求注册、姓名或出生日期。选择仅在当前页面内存中计算，不保存到本地草稿，不随分享链接发送。刷新、关闭页面或重测会清除选择；清空操作需要确认。
answer.en: No account, name or birth date is required. Selections are evaluated in the current page’s memory, without a saved local draft or answers in sharing links. Reloading, closing the page or retaking clears them; clearing selections asks for confirmation.
